'''Joran Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was used as stopover point between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]] and [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Jai Maruk]] and [[Maks Leem]] traveled through it on their way to Vjun. Accompanying them were [[Padawan]]s [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] and [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]].
